column1: Jarvis Topic Manager — Ports, Protocols and Services Management (PPSM)

column2: Every port, protocol and service the Topic Manager host listens on or initiates. Ports marked operator-defined come from configuration. Live applied settings shown; unavailable state is explicit. Static PPSM describes installer defaults.

column6: Description
Topic Manager web UI and REST API. nginx TLS termination: TLS 1.2 and 1.3 only, FIPS-approved cipher suites (ECDHE with AES-GCM).
Redirect to HTTPS only (301). No content is served on this port. Enabled by applied http_redirect_enabled.
Operating-system administration of the host (key-based). Not used by the application.

Host mail transfer agent, present where the host baseline installs one (a STIG baseline installs Postfix for audit alerts). As installed it listens on ALL interfaces (0.0.0.0:25 and [::]:25, inet_interfaces = all; measured on a STIG-hardened Ubuntu 24.04 host). Not used by the application, and the installer does not change it. Hardening option where the host only sends mail by local submission: inet_interfaces = loopback-only (postconf -e inet_interfaces=loopback-only, then systemctl restart postfix), or block 25/tcp at the host firewall.

column1: --- INTERNAL (loopback and local sockets; not reachable off the host) ---

column6: nginx to the application backend over the Unix socket /run/topic-manager/gunicorn.sock, 0660 topic-manager:www-data, created by systemd (topic-manager.socket). No TCP port (before v1.2.0: TCP 5001 on the loopback).
Local stub resolvers 127.0.0.53:53 and 127.0.0.54:53 (the proxy-only stub), both loopback. Host service, not part of the application.
chronyd command port for chronyc, bound to 127.0.0.1 and ::1 by chrony. Host time service, present when chrony is the time daemon.
Authentication and group-membership check against the directory named in auth.ldap_server. TLS certificate validation is enforced. Plain LDAP (389) is not used.
Kafka AdminClient to the brokers named in each cluster profile. Commonly 9092 PLAINTEXT and 9093/9094 SSL or SASL_SSL; the profiles decide.
Name resolution for the directory and Kafka broker host names.
Time synchronisation by the host time service. Required for TLS validity and audit timestamps. Host configuration unchanged (empty applied ntp_servers).
Disabled; applied protocol: tls. Remote forwarding of app audit and nginx logs. This row applies when udp or tcp is selected; port is syslog_port.
Disabled; applied protocol: tls. TLS remote forwarding of app audit and nginx logs. This row applies when tls is selected; port is syslog_port.

rsyslog UDP sender sockets: ephemeral high ports bound to 0.0.0.0, created for UDP forwarding (this product when Remote syslog is applied with udp, or the host own forwarding rules). rsyslog reads nothing from them; this product loads no UDP input (imudp).
NOT USED. Neither nginx nor the application fetches OCSP responses or CRLs; certificate revocation is not checked online.

column1: --- OUTBOUND (online install and upgrade ONLY; none of these at runtime or on an air-gapped host) ---

column6: OS packages (nginx, python3-venv, polkitd). Port 80 unless the configured mirror is HTTPS.
Python wheels for the pinned dependency set.
Vue.js runtime, verified against a pinned SHA-256 before use.
Online upgrade only: git clone of the release source. No default; the offline bundle needs no network at all.
Software composition analysis (tools/sca-check.sh). Developer or CI workstation only, never the target host.
/opt/topic-manager/data/tm.db: audit log, server-side sessions and app settings. File 0600 and directory 0700, owned by the topic-manager service account.
Holds the server-side session id only, signed with HMAC-SHA-256. HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax.
UI preferences only (theme, last Settings section). No credentials or sensitive data.
/etc/topic-manager/tls/server.key, 0600 root:root on a fresh install. An upgraded host keeps its recorded mode.
/etc/topic-manager/config.yaml, 0640 root:topic-manager. Holds the session signing key and, if a service account is configured, the LDAP bind password.
/var/backups/topic-manager/, 0700 root:root. Holds config, TLS key and audit database; archives are 0600.
